Challenges

Each challenge is a fixed enemy army. Build your own army with 100 points and beat it. You can adjust and retry as often as you like.

Skirmish

Opponent
Points to spend

Both sides get the same budget and buy up to 24 kobolds. Swarm units are cheap and weak, elites are costly and mighty. Mushrooms are off, so the fight comes down to who you pick. The computer runs practice fights to choose its army, and studies yours when it loses.

Tower War

Opponent

One tunnel joins two hoards. Each player has a hoard and a cave at their own end, and the half of the board nearest them is theirs.

Send kobolds from your cave toward the other hoard. Every kobold you send raises your income for the rest of the game. When troops from both sides meet in the tunnel they stop and brawl.

Build towers on the stone pads in your half: tap a pad, pick a tower. Tap a tower to upgrade or sell it. Knocking out enemy kobolds pays a bounty.

Each hoard has 20 lives. Empty the other hoard to win. For two players, lay the device flat between you: the top player's menu is upside down so it faces them.

Player 1: ban a unit

Pick one unit type that nobody may buy this match. Player 2 bans one next.
